long_biography.plain_text:
Stratakis graduated from Amherst College and started her career at Deutsche Bank. After completing an MBA at London Business School, she returned to Greece in 2010 and entered the family enterprise. That sequence gave her experience outside the group before she assumed responsibilities within a business established by Anastasios and Angele Nomikos in 1958.

The company began in coastal trade and expanded across the principal dry-bulk segments, later adding container management. Its Athens headquarters oversees technical, crewing, safety, accounting and procurement services, while the London office supports commercial activity. Stratakis's public service developed alongside this maritime setting. Official annual reports name her to the board of SYN-ENOSIS, the Greek Shipowners' Social Welfare Company, during that reporting period.
